caption: The drawing is a technical sketch rendered in pencil on a beige or off-white paper background. It features detailed diagrams of a round table with a scalloped-edged top. The composition includes a top view, a side view, and a sectional view through the tabletop. The top view displays a circular tabletop with a scalloped edge, measuring 33 inches in diameter, with three curved legs radiating from a central point. The side view shows the table's profile, including the tabletop, a central column, and three intricately shaped legs that curve outward with claw-like feet. The sectional view in the upper right corner illustrates the cross-section of the tabletop's edge. Various measurements, labels, and construction notes annotate the drawing. There is a boxed section in the lower right corner containing the title “Table,” a reference number (#14069), location details for the “Parlor of the Governor's House, Providence, R.I.,” and the name “Brooklyn Museum.” The drawing is monochrome, with all lines, text, and shading appearing in shades of gray.
